DecorationPreset24_Scrooge/Scrooge_MRQS0.en: Aye, there ya are, {PlayerName}. It's a good thing you came by, for I've got a brilliant new way to decorate, if ya care to hear about it.
Yes, I would.
No, I don't have time right now.
Well, ya know all the fine decor items you've been collectin', your rugs and potted plants and what not? What if I told ya there's a faster and easier way to arrange it?
Great, I love decorating!
If it makes decorating simpler, I'm in.
Does it involve L-shaped couches?
Then you'll love this!

I dug up an invention that my old friend Gyro Gearloose built. He calls it a <Lore>Decor Preset</Lore>. That's a fancy way of sayin' you can <Lore>group decor items you've placed</Lore>, so you can use the same arrangement more than once.
You'll find Gyro's <Lore>Presets</Lore> in your magical Backpack along with the rest of your items.
After ya make a <Lore>Preset</Lore>, use it as many times as you like! Assuming, of course, you've got the decor items to fill it up... But more about that later.
So, I could make a <Lore>Decor Preset</Lore> for...
...a table and chairs?
...a fountain with bushes and rocks nearby?
...pictures on a wall?
Aye! The possibilities are nearly endless. Why don't ya try makin' one right now?
Simple as falling off a log, and far less painful too!
It can! In fact, it's an especially good idea for L-shaped couches.
Och, you dinnae know what you're missin'!
Go on now. Open that magical Backpack of yours, arrange some decor items, and then turn it into a <Lore>Preset</Lore>!
If you've already made a <Lore>Decor Preset</Lore>, you can re-use it anytime. Just find it in your magical Backpack, put it down wherever ya like, and Bob McRobert's your uncle!
That <ActivityItem>Picnic Decor Preset</ActivityItem> should be in your magical Backpack along with the other <Lore>Presets</Lore>. Just take it out and put it down wherever ya like.
That <Lore>Preset</Lore> seems to have a piece missing. Try adding some crafting materials to finish it off.
Just as I suspected, {PlayerName}; ya took to <Lore>Decor Presets</Lore> like gravy to haggis!
If ya make use of <Lore>Decor Presets</Lore>, you'll have an easier time decoratin' your home, the Valley, and lands beyond.
Well, sparkle me spats, {PlayerName}! That's a fine job of decoratin' you've done.
Gyro gave me a <Lore>Preset</Lore> I'm happy to pass along to you. He calls it a <Lore>Premade Decor Preset</Lore>, seein' as how he's already done the design work.
Thanks, Mr. McDuck!
I appreciate it!
That's unexpectedly generous of you.
There's got to be a catch.
Well now, nothing's for free, of course. If someone gives you a <Lore>Premade Decor Preset</Lore>, that doesn't mean they're givin' away the decor items too.
When you're placin' a <Lore>Preset</Lore>, ya might notice some parts of it are shadowy like a <Lore>Mirage</Lore>. That's to let ya know that item's not in your Backpack yet.
Depending on what the missing item is, you can craft it or buy it after you've put the <Lore>Preset</Lore> in place. Both convenient options for my favorite customer!
Why don't ya give it a try? The <Lore>Preset</Lore> I just gave ya will make for a grand picnic.
Are ya having any trouble setting up the <Lore>Picnic Decor Preset</Lore> I gave ya?
I don't know where to start.
I'm missing some pieces.
I'm fine, thanks.
Well, just open up your magical Backpack like you normally do to place decor items. You should see <Lore>Presets</Lore> in there.
Then, choose the <Lore>Picnic Decor Preset</Lore> and set it down anywhere ya like.
Aye, that can be a problem. You might not have a <ActivityItem>Floral Fae Picnic Blanket</ActivityItem> yet, so it'll show up as a shadowy <Lore>Mirage</Lore>.

Just take a good look at the <Lore>Preset</Lore> after you've set it in place and add the missing crafting materials. Mind ya, other <Lore>Presets</Lore> might require Star Coins instead. After all, I've got to keep my business thriving!
Then go on, set up that <Lore>Picnic Decor Preset</Lore> somewhere nice and charming.
